data.indexCnDesc: 中证全指由上海证券交易所、深圳证券交易所和北京证券交易所市场符合条件的股票和存托凭证组成样本，具有较高的市场代表性，反映上交所、深交所和北交所市场上市公司的整体表现。
data.indexEnDesc: CSI All Share Index is composed of all eligible securities in Shanghai Stock Exchange (SSE), Shenzhen Stock Exchange(SZSE) or Beijing Stock Exchange (BSE) listed securities. The index is highly representative of the market and reflects the price performance of listed securities in SSE, SZSE or BSE.
